opportunities.title: Research Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: RSC members holding Associate Member (AMRSC), Member (MRSC) or Fellow (FRSC) membership; must hold an independent research post; not currently holding another active Research Fund grant; applications limited to one per department with Head of Department support.
opportunities.summary: Supports RSC members with limited access to research funds to start new projects, particularly those in less well-funded institutes, developing countries, and early career researchers. Covers chemicals/equipment, consumables, software licences, equipment repairs and equipment access. 2026 Round 2 opens 12 October 2026 and closes 30 November 2026.

opportunities.title: Outreach Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants must be aged 18 and over; be a UK or Republic of Ireland resident (with UK/ROI address and bank account) or apply on behalf of an organisation registered in the UK/ROI; project must have a significant aspect related to the chemical sciences.
opportunities.summary: Supports members, individuals and organisations to run chemistry-based engagement and outreach activities that connect communities with the chemical sciences. Open for applications throughout 2026 with rolling deadlines; final deadline 2 October 2026 at 5pm. Three application rounds in 2026 (6 March, 5 June, 2 October).
